result.summary: The home screen is mostly intact. One layout issue stands out: a restaurant card title is clipped by the right edge in the Fastest near you row (beyond typical last-item peek).

issues.description: In the Fastest near you carousel, the third card’s restaurant name is truncated as “Trattoria Piccol” with no ellipsis, so the title is cut off at the screen edge rather than gracefully truncated.
issues.suggestion: Constrain card titles with a max width and single-line ellipsis (or wrap) so names remain readable even when the last card is only partially on screen.
